units.titles: Users can evade having blocked funds destroyed by using uppercase addresses
units.known_address_notes: Oak Security 2022-05-25 audited the Terraform Labs CW20 Blocklist CosmWasm module (octalmage/terra-blocklist, repo live). It is a module instantiated per integrator token, not a single protocol deployment; no canonical instance address is published in the report or repo. Terra chain otherwise unaffected. PARTIAL: code identified, exact instance unpublished by design.

CODESPECT 2026-01 audited the Canopy Anchor program (setup_tge_distribution, start_airdrop_handler, groves/plots accounts). Audited repo canopyfi/canopy is 404; the only public canopyfi repo is canopy-mobile. The report gives no program ID and no app URL. Canopy's live deployment documented elsewhere is the Movement/Aptos Move package (b10bd32b... per DefiLlama/docs), not the audited Solana program. Solana program ID unpublished, so PARTIAL.

units.titles: Advanced users can influence which ship traits they receive from auctions
units.known_address_notes: 0xMacro Citadel-1 (2022-11) audited Pixel/Stark-style ZK ship-game contracts (Reveal circuit, DutchAuctionShips, ConstructionBay, ShipTraits) for thecitadelgame. Repo github.com/thecitadelgame/contracts is private/404; the 0xMacro audit repo is also private. Polygon Blockscout searches for ConstructionBay/DutchAuctionShips/ShipTraits return nothing (contracts unverified or named differently), and 'Citadel' returns unrelated tokens. Core game existed on Polygon, address book unpublished.
